summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file, private reader and context wrapper), added 22 tests in tests/test_progress.py, added docs subsections in docs/source/progress.rst, and added a CHANGELOG entry linking PR 1759. Nothing is committed. Tests, mypy, black, and isort were not run because the task forbade running repository code, so all verification was by reading. Choices to review: added mode and name properties on the reader, typed the module-level context wrapper as Any so no extra type-checker suppressions were needed, and used Literal["r","rt","rb"] in implementation signatures.
